==Description==
'''Ok Walker''' is an exclusive sticker obtained from the [[Null & Void Event]]. It was obtained from Level 38 of the premium track, which had a cost of {{GumDrops|1,125}} or {{Robux|72}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|19,295}} or {{Robux|2,982}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|90}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{Robux|3,745}}.

==Appearance==
'''Ok Walker''' showcases the [[Rift Walker]] with a neutral expression. A speech bubbles appears next to it, with only has "''OK.''" in it. When used, a sound of [[Rift Walker]] saying "''Ok.''" plays.

==Trivia==
*This sticker is based on [[w:c:onepunchman:Saitama|Saitama]] which utterly said [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/saitama-ok "OK"] when confronting [[w:c:onepunchman:Boros|Boros]].
